3m-ui · Web frontend not embedded

This binary contains only a placeholder in backend/cmd/server/web/dist and no Vite build output, so the panel UI cannot load.

Build the frontend and replace the embed directory first:

cd frontend && npm install && npm run build
rm -rf backend/cmd/server/web/dist
cp -r frontend/dist backend/cmd/server/web/dist
cd backend
CGO_ENABLED=0 go build -tags sqlite_modernc -trimpath -ldflags='-s -w' -o ../3m-ui ./cmd/server

Or run make build-linux from the repository root. Its frontend-assets target performs the steps above and writes per-architecture binaries to dist/.

See the build section in the README.

A compatible Mihomo binary must also be installed locally, with its path set in the configuration.
